if: the supply is a supply of services
it is not possible to determine the time of supply under s.13(2), s.13(3) or s.13(4)
then: the time of supply is the date on which a periodical return is to be filed, where one has to be filed, and otherwise the date on which the tax is paid
note: The residual limb for services, worded as in s.12(5).

evidence.quote: Where  it  is  not  possible  to  determine  the  time  of  supply  under  the provisions of sub-section (2) or sub-section (3) or sub-section (4), the time of supply
evidence.extraction_note: As in s.12(5), the extraction breaks the trailing dash of 'shall––' across a line. The quote stops before 'shall'. Both sections carry the identical sentence, so this span is found in either.

evidence.quote: in a case where a periodical return has to be filed, be the date on which such return is to be filed
in any other case, be the date on which the tax is paid.
